name: Swipe gesture
summary: Touch-screen swipe hint: a pointing hand slides left, right, up or down with a trail and arrow, on a loop.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the swipe path

params.name: y
params.note: centre y of the swipe path

params.name: dist
params.note: swipe length in px at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: arrow and trail colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

author: krakujs
